title: Actor Anna Rajan brings home brand-new Toyota Innova Hycross
content: Malayalam actor Anna Rajan, widely recognised for her breazy role in Lijo Jose Pellissery's critically acclaimed film Angamaly Diaries, has added a premium ride to her collection. The actor has purchased a brand-new Toyota Innova Hycross MPV from Kairali Toyota, a prominent dealership in Kochi. Anna chose the Petrol GX 7-seater variant of the Innova Hycross. This highly popular multi-purpose vehicle has a strong market presence in India, with prices ranging from 18.70 lakh to 32.95 lakh (ex-showroom), depending on the variant and engine configurations. From nursing to stardom Before stepping into the limelight of the Malayalam film industry, Anna Rajan worked as a professional nurse. Her life took a cinematic turn when she was cast as 'Lichi' in Angamaly Diaries, a breakthrough role that made her an instant favourite among Malayali audience. Following her stellar debut, she went on to feature in several notable films, including Velipadinte Pusthakam, Madhura Raja, and the action-drama Ayyappanum Koshiyum. What makes the Toyota Innova Hycross stand out? The Toyota Innova Hycross offers impressive performance and versatility. The strong hybrid variant features a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine paired with an electric system, generating a combined power output of 184 BHP. This hybrid system is mated to an e-CVT automatic transmission and delivers an exceptional fuel efficiency of 23.34 km/l. Alternatively, the vehicle is also available with a non-hybrid 2.0-litre naturally aspirated petrol engine that puts out 173 BHP and 209 Nm of torque. This version is coupled with a CVT automatic gearbox and offers a fuel efficiency of 16.13 km/l. Designed to meet diverse family needs, the Innova Hycross is sold in both spacious 7-seater and 8-seater configurations.
